research_claim: Sources document workflows, not customer demand, contracted users, feed availability or Matter accuracy. Every scenario and organization is invented.
execution: No source in this catalog is ingested, connected or evaluated by virtue of being listed. Initial runtime remains two saved objectives, capture only.

sources.title: USAC E-Rate competitive bidding

sources.title: Overland Park development review

sources.title: NC Broadband rights of way

sources.title: Grants.gov eligibility

sources.title: EPA public comment opportunities

sources.title: KCC public comments

sources.title: GSA solicitation research

sources.title: LA Metro participation

sources.title: DOL construction contract tools

sources.title: FEMA flood map updates
sources.workflow_basis: Map revisions and effective-map status can matter to specific properties; preliminary information is not automatically effective.

proposed_objective.purpose: Prepare school connectivity policy and hearing decisions, separate from vendor selection.
proposed_objective.scope: school connectivity policy, facilities and public hearings
proposed_objective.positions: Explicit provision-level choices only; unspecified is unknown.
proposed_objective.responsibility: A named role selected by the user; no inferred assignment.
proposed_objective.timing_delivery: Capture only; explicit notice deadlines and host-selected immediate/digest checkpoint.
proposed_objective.exclusions: Routine mention of broadband in acknowledgements; an unchanged agenda reprint.

scenarios.invented_development: A committee recommends a connectivity policy and publishes a hearing notice.
scenarios.illustrative_useful_output: Digest the proposal and hearing opportunity; retain recommendation-only status.
scenarios.expected_silence: Routine mention of broadband in acknowledgements; an unchanged agenda reprint.
scenarios.correction_control: A corrected notice moves the hearing; correct the actual prior captured date.
scenarios.contrasting_audience: District technology supplier needs an open procurement, so policy discussion alone stays quiet.

proposed_objective.timing_delivery: Capture only; explicit notice deadlines and host-selected immediate/digest checkpoint.
proposed_objective.exclusions: Connectivity policy recommendation without a solicitation; award close-out for an old purchase.

scenarios.invented_development: An actual request for network services is published with a submission deadline.
scenarios.illustrative_useful_output: Inspect the service scope and explicit dates; capture a fitting solicitation or amendment.
scenarios.expected_silence: Connectivity policy recommendation without a solicitation; award close-out for an old purchase.
scenarios.correction_control: An amendment changes eligible equipment or deadline; do not treat the minimum waiting period as the bid deadline.
scenarios.contrasting_audience: The school board may care about policy even before an actionable solicitation exists.

scenarios.invented_development: A planning recommendation changes access conditions on the project and schedules a hearing.

scenarios.invented_development: A published zoning or map notice specifically affects an approved property scope.

scenarios.invented_development: A proposed tariff changes industrial demand charges or a permit docket changes an operating condition.
scenarios.illustrative_useful_output: Capture the matching provision and review window; do not estimate costs without approved consumption data.
